name: empty-then-load
what: Candidate A followed by the load finishing: Cee's tab is read with no tracks and every record (as empty-project), then 1.5 s later the file is in place again (a new opening, before mirror.EMPTY_SECS runs out). Nothing may go out, and the song must be there once: no track put back twice beside the loaded one.

checks.what: the song is whole, once: Drums (4 items), Bass (4), Keys (2), Gtr (1)
checks.lua: for name, n in pairs({ Drums = 4, Bass = 4, Keys = 2, Gtr = 1 }) do local t = track(name); assert(t, 'no ' .. name); assert(#t.items == n, name .. ' has ' .. #t.items .. ' items') end; assert(#F.tracks == 4, #F.tracks .. ' tracks')
